harness.note: The better-borg-c runner and observer at this commit build and run every specimen. A specimen is the game and Borg source at its own ref; the observer instrumentation comes from the harness commit. It applies to specimens of kind "better-borg-c" (the default). Specimens of kind "borg-rs" are built and run by borg-rs's own harness at the specimen's ref (harness/build.sh and the borgh frontend). This pin is also a specimen ref (4.2.6-bbc-9ca98661): the harness bumped with the mode-cutoff restart so runner and specimens move together (borg-zoo#54).

experiment.prespecified: Fixed 2026-11-25, before any result (Rule 22, #758). The owner's suspect, tested: the #1217 rework replaced the max-HP 30 DL2 gate with per-class character-level gates (6-10, live for all nine classes through the shipped __class overrides; the global 0 alone would disable it, which is why every override is zeroed in prep_old). prep_old restores the historical gate (max-HP 30, no level gate) on the current build; paired by seed against ship, classes-18, normal world, 100,000 turns. Read: identical plays (how many games the gate moves), CL5, deaths (deaths-0 for the arm; a rise cannot be adopted), paired gained/lost (exact McNemar), median first-L5, and per-class splits (the shipped values differ by class: casters 9-10 vs warrior 6). Gate: no config_error; one binary; every cell terminal; each arm's values in params-core.json. Descriptive (RULES 14) - a lead goes to a bigger tier on the owner's word.
